observations.the_garden_of_death: Four garden visits and tablet translations, with a free Molch boat crossing and 10,000 Farming XP at completion.
observations.getting_ahead: The tracks and Headless Beast lead into the replica-head stages. Farm and mine supplies are available locally. Fur can be hunted or purchased. Gordon opens the tannery.
observations.alfred_grimhands_barcrawl: All ten drinks may be ordered independently after obtaining the card. The listed drinks cost 208 GP before transportation. The gate and optional vial-smashing dialogue are separate.
observations.scorpion_catcher: The 31 Prayer gate is at the monastery ladder. The Taverley route includes the dusty-key branch and both Agility shortcuts. The third scorpion uses the completed Barcrawl.
observations.spirits_of_the_elid: Telekinetic Grab grants its ordinary spell XP. The three golems check the corresponding weapon styles and separate skill gates. The crevice rope and light source enable the genie trip and return diary visit.
observations.the_feud: Disguise, camel receipts, pickpocket stages, villa, poison and the two fights precede the reward. Pick up the willow blackjack before fighting the Bandit Champion for the scimitar.
observations.the_tourist_trap: Outfit checks and movement cover both mining camp visits, the prototype, lower mine, cart and winch. Dart smithing starts with the prototype handover. Irena's completion dialogue has two 4,650 XP selections.
observations.the_slug_menace: The investigation uses the independent witness and page stages. Five shaped runes can use rune or pure essence, charge separately at their altars and unlock the prince fight. Savant returns the player to Tiffy after victory.
